source_clauses.verbatim: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I need a clamp that fixes a monitor arm to the edge of my desk.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp is able to fix a monitor arm to the edge of a desk.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Desk edges here are between 18 and 40 mm thick.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp fits desk edges with thickness between 18 and 40 mm.

requirements.statement_verbatim: Once it is tight it must not slip or rotate under the weight of the arm.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp does not slip or rotate when tightened and subjected to the weight of the arm.

requirements.statement_verbatim: I want to be able to take it off and move it to another desk without any tools.
requirements.observable_verbatim: The clamp can be removed and moved to another desk without the use of tools.

scenarios.name: Clamp installation and operation
scenarios.system_boundary: Inside: the clamp and the monitor arm. Outside: the desk edge and the environment.
scenarios.environment: A desk with an edge thickness between 18 and 40 mm.

freedoms.decision: The mechanism by which the clamp fixes the monitor arm to the desk edge.
freedoms.why_free: The request does not specify how the clamp should achieve this.

freedoms.decision: The mechanism by which the clamp is tightened.
freedoms.why_free: The request does not specify how the clamp is tightened.

freedoms.decision: The mechanism by which the clamp is removed and moved to another desk.
freedoms.why_free: The request does not specify how the removal is accomplished.

freedoms.decision: The materials used for the clamp.
freedoms.why_free: The request does not specify materials.

freedoms.decision: The dimensions of the clamp (other than the range of desk edge thickness it must fit).
freedoms.why_free: The request does not specify dimensions.

ambiguities.statement: The weight of the arm is not specified.
ambiguities.resolvable_when: Additional information about the monitor arm's weight is obtained.

ambiguities.statement: The clamp must fit desk edges between 18 and 40 mm thick, but the clamp's own size is not specified.

assumptions.statement: The monitor arm is attached to the clamp.
assumptions.why: The request implies a monitor arm is fixed to the desk via the clamp.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: The request is reinterpreted to mean the clamp is used to fix the arm directly to the desk without a separate attachment.
